statements.status_notes: Fixed in wasmtime-wasi 48.0.4+. influxdb3-core ships wasmtime-wasi 41.0.4 as part of the wasmtime 41.x ecosystem pinned by datafusion-udf-wasm-host; upgrading wasmtime-wasi independently is blocked by the same upstream constraint and build breakage observed when forcing wasmtime 48.x.

The fixed release is wasmtime-wasi 48.0.3, but influxdb3 pins wasmtime ^41.0.1 via datafusion-udf-wasm-host. cargo update to 48.0.3 fails resolver constraints; waiting for an upstream influxdb release that moves the wasmtime ecosystem forward.

The fixed release is wasmtime-wasi 48.0.3, but influxdb3 pins wasmtime ^41.0.1 via datafusion-udf-wasm-host. cargo update to 48.0.3 fails resolver constraints; waiting for an upstream influxdb release that moves the wasmtime ecosystem forward.

The fix requires upgrading wasmtime-wasi from 41.0.4 to at least 44.0.3, which crosses multiple Cargo major version boundaries. wasmtime-wasi is a companion crate to wasmtime and cannot be upgraded independently; datafusion-udf-wasm-host constrains wasmtime to ^41.0.1. Waiting for an upstream fix or backport that updates the wasmtime ecosystem without introducing incompatible dependency changes.
